parts.name: Fan Blades
parts.Basic_description: These are the rotating blades of the ceiling fan, typically made of lightweight aluminum for efficient air movement.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades convert the rotational motion of the motor into airflow, circulating air throughout the room.
parts.Movement_description: They rotate around the central hub when powered by the motor, maintaining a fixed pitch angle.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the central housing of the ceiling fan, typically made of steel to support the motor and blades.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the electric motor and provides structural support for the fan blades and mounting system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the blades rotate around it.
